about: Large public downloads kept in the shared .cache/, not in git. A test may name a path with @pytest.mark.local_dataset only if it is listed here (tests/conftest.py). `uv run python scripts/fetch_download.py <path>` fetches an entry and keeps it only if its size and SHA-256 match. Each sha256 is that of the copy the tests were run against.
